_help: Act 3, the small town after the ambush (desert or coast -> town): Rashid Amin (elder) and Mariam Amin (merchant). Resupply clears supplies_lost for 15; the Germans are a day ahead. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act3.py.

start.speaker: rashid
start.line: We heard the shooting from the wadi. Welcome to our town, if you have come in peace. I am Rashid Amin; I keep the peace here, such as it is.

choices.label: Ask about the riders
choices.line: The riders who hit us. Who are they?

choices.label: Resupply
choices.line: Water and food for the road. We lost our truck.

choices.label: Buy water
choices.line: Water for the last stretch, if you can spare it.

choices.label: Ask the way
choices.line: How far to the old ruins west of here?

choices.label: Move on
choices.line: Thank you. We'll be on our way.

riders.speaker: rashid
riders.line: They came through two days ago, asking about foreigners with maps. They paid for their water and harmed no one. Men like that frighten me more than thieves.

resupply.speaker: mariam
resupply.line: Mariam Amin. One hundred and fifty pounds for water and flour enough to reach the ruins, and I will not cheat you, whatever they say about my prices.

water.speaker: mariam
water.line: Fifty pounds, and the skins are new.

way.speaker: rashid
way.line: Two days west, past the black rocks. The Germans asked the same yesterday. They did not stop to drink.

bye.speaker: rashid
bye.line: Go carefully. And if you meet the men in dark robes again, listen to them.
